searchText: I found a book mode ([official guide](https://hackmd.io/c/tutorials/%2F%40docs%2Fcreate-a-book-en)) of HackMD is useful to consolidate my weekly updates & write-ups. Example: https://hackmd.io/@junsong/SkB51ZR1be Is it possible to download a full book as a pdf? Not sure, but IIRC exporting a document as a PDF requires premium membership of HackMD
